title: A per-host install section in the README, all four hosts
description:
The README must itself tell a reader how to install the SOBER plugin into the agentic tool they use — not link them elsewhere for it. Write one subsection per host under the guide's install step, each with the exact commands and each stating the shared prerequisite once: `sober` has to be on PATH (`npm i -g @besober/cli`) because every host's MCP declaration and Claude Code's hooks.json name that command.

Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add memoksin/sober` then `/plugin install sober@sober` — no checkout, Claude Code clones the repository itself from the root .claude-plugin/marketplace.json; plus the settings.json route (extraKnownMarketplaces + enabledPlugins) for a team that wants it present on checkout.
Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add <path to checkout>` then `codex plugin add sober@sober` — a checkout is required, because .agents/plugins/marketplace.json declares source `local` with path ./packages/codex-plugin.
Cursor: symlink packages/cursor-plugin into ~/.cursor/plugins/local/sober, reload, confirm under Customize — checkout required.
OpenCode: copy packages/opencode-plugin/.opencode into the project or ~/.config/opencode/, and merge the mcp block of opencode.json — checkout required.

Each subsection ends with the one line that matters for that host, taken from the Hosts table rather than repeating it: whether decisions can be asked in session, and whether an attended run is possible. Verify every command against the repository before writing it; a command that does not run is worse than a link.
